title: Golden Match F — Camogie: senior adult club championship (Camogie Official Guide 2025, standard playing rules)

truth.note: sideline puck directly over, untouched in flight → 2 points (Rule 15.4)
first offence — yellow card warning, no time off (Rule 10)
sideline puck wide — one missed placed-ball attempt (Rule 11.3)
sideline puck touched in flight, then over → 1 point (Rule 15.4)
… followed by a red card and dismissal (Rule 10)
foul in the large parallelogram — penalty (Rule 11.13)
